items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's Ripa, Alexis, brother. That's Ripa. Saxophone, who was in California now.

ctx.x: Who is in California now. We had Kingston. Trumphant. Trumphant. Let's get his full name again, huh? Kingston what? That's Ripa, Alexis, brother. That's Ripa. Saxophone, who was in California now. We had Kingston's trumpet.
Let's get his full name again, huh? Kingston what?
